tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Reads direct contact channels such as email addresses, telephone numbers, and contact page paths for Cadarsir.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists completed portfolio case studies from Cadarsir, including project titles, summaries, slugs, and destination URLs, with optional keyword filtering.

query.description: Optional search term to filter projects by title, summary, or slug.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Navigates to a specific portfolio project case study page.

url.description: Relative path or absolute URL of the project case study (e.g., '/portfolio/le-coq-noir').
